canonical_project: TA Infrastructure Management Duck Island data-center module
aliases: TA Infrastructure Management Duck Island data-center module
status_as_of_cutoff: Approved-permitted temporary pilot; module reportedly installed but not yet connected to power as of the Alaska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission's March 13, 2025 decision as reported by Petroleum News. Operation, energization, and any larger buildout were not verified. The public record describes a 1.4 MW bitcoin-mining demonstration module using existing Hilcorp generation, not a large AI campus.
evidence_grade: B: Alaska DNR public notice and permit application provide official application/capacity evidence; DNR permit approval and AOGCC metering decision are supported by contemporaneous Petroleum News reporting, while direct AOGCC/DNR decision documents were not publicly retrievable in this refresh.

actions.result_status: DNR public notice records receipt of TA Infrastructure Management LLC's application for a trial data-center module at the Duck Island Unit / Satellite Drilling Island.
actions.case_or_ordinance_permit_number: Duck Island Unit, Satellite Drilling Island Data Center Land Use Permit
actions.access_caveat: The public-notice page is an application notice; a final decision and later inspection file were not exposed.
actions.evidence_note: Official application evidence; no approval, construction, operation, or load inferred.

actions.government_body: Alaska Department of Natural Resources, Division of Oil and Gas
actions.result_status: Permit approval for installation of a temporary data-center module at Satellite Drilling Island reported by Petroleum News; direct DNR approval document was not found in indexed public sources during this refresh.
actions.access_caveat: Secondary report quoting/describing the DNR approval; the DNR approval letter itself was not retrieved.
actions.evidence_note: Supports status update from application-only to approved-permitted, but does not verify operation or energization.

actions.government_body: Alaska Oil and Gas Conservation Commission
actions.action_type: metering waiver / non-custody transfer meter decision
actions.result_status: AOGCC approved, with conditions, Hilcorp's request to use non-custody transfer meters for power sold to the Duck Island third-party data-center pilot; Petroleum News reported the data-center module had been installed but was not yet connected to power.
actions.access_caveat: Secondary report; the AOGCC data portal is public but the source order/document search was not accessible without browser challenge in this refresh.
actions.evidence_note: Supports site-work/installation evidence and continued not-energized caveat; no later operating confirmation found.
